subject: Infra telemetry contract review & action plan
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@datadog.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@grafana.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi@sentry.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Infra telemetry contract review & action plan

Hi all,

Quick context: our current contracts for Datadog and Grafana Cloud (and Sentry for error monitoring) are up for renewal in Q3 and we need to align on retention/cost options and a unified timeline. I pulled a short cost breakdown for Q2 usage (attached) — spikes on log ingestion in May drove the last-month overage that pushed us into the procurement review.

As a first step I want a single 30-minute working session with vendor reps and our infra + procurement leads to: 
- Confirm renewal windows and any automatic renewals/notice periods.
- Surface retention-tier options and estimated monthly spend for 30/90/365-day retention.
- Identify opportunities for consolidation or cross-product discounts (Grafana Logs vs Datadog logs, Sentry for exceptions).

Please reply with availability this week (prefer mornings PDT) and any pre-read or quote IDs you want me to include in the shared folder.

Attachments: cost_breakdown_q2.xlsx (spreadsheet - usage + overage line items)

Thanks,

David Kim
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Park <sam.park@datadog.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infra telemetry contract review & action plan

Hi David — thanks for the note and the breakdown. I pulled the usage for your account and there are a few levers we can recommend: retention tier changes, log processing filters, and a committed-usage discount for a 12-month reserved plan. I attached a draft renewal quote (datadog_renewal_quote_48932.pdf) and included projected monthly spend for 30/90/365-day retention based on May usage.

Key items in the quote: 
- Option A: 30-day retention (current ingestion profile) — baseline pricing + ingestion overage protection.
- Option B: 90-day retention with 10% reserved commit — reduces per-GB cost but increases storage.
- Option C: 365-day archival tier (cold storage) with retrieval fees; best if you need long-term audit logs.

I can join a working session Thursday morning (2026-07-01) at 09:00 PDT or Friday 08:30 PDT. If you want a tailored estimate, please confirm the accounts you want included (prod only, prod + staging, or all environments).

Quote link: https://www.docusign.com/ren/48932

Cheers,
Sam Park
Enterprise Sales, Datadog

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infra telemetry contract review & action plan

Thanks David and Sam — a few notes from infra/observability: 

Current footprint (high level):
- Datadog: primary APM + logs for prod services; approx 18 TB/month ingest across prod clusters (peak in May).
- Grafana Cloud: metrics + some hosted Loki ingestion for non-prod + dashboards; currently 7 TB/month logs.
- Sentry: exception capture (errors) across frontend and backend; counts are event-based, not heavy on size.

Our priorities for the review:
1) Keep 30-day hot retention for prod logs to meet SLO debugging needs.
2) Look for cheaper cold/archival options for 90-365 day retention; 365d required for some compliance audit trails.
3) Reduce cross-product duplication (we have overlapping logs in Datadog and Grafana for some infra services).

Questions for vendors ahead of the call:
- Grafana: can you show a combined cost for moving non-prod logs entirely to Grafana Cloud with a 90-day standard retention and optional cold tier?
- Datadog: do you have a committed ingest discount for 12-month auto-renew, and what are the penalties/notice period for termination?
- Sentry: confirm that we can export event archives to object store for long-term retention and approximate monthly cost for exports.

I've added a short worksheet (linked in Drive) with environment toggles — please pull the numbers you used for projections into that sheet so procurement has a single source of truth.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Observability
From: Elena Rossi <elena@grafana.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@vendor-ops.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infra telemetry contract review & action plan

Hi Laura / David — thanks for the details. Grafana Cloud can offer a bundled logs+metrics plan for non-prod that is typically cheaper than running duplicate logs in Datadog. I've attached a short PDF with a suggested bundle and pricing tiers (grafana_cloud_bundle.pdf).

Highlights: 
- Non-prod consolidation: move staging and dev logs (7 TB/mo) to Grafana Cloud 90-day retention — estimated savings ~28% vs current split.
- Cold archiving: 365-day archive to object storage with integrated retrieval; small monthly fee plus retrieval per-GB.
- Volume commitment: 12-month commitment reduces unit price by ~12% and includes free ingestion filtering tooling consultation.

I can join Thursday 09:00 PDT to walk the bundle or send an updated model if you want additional constraints (e.g., only certain namespaces).

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Grafana Labs

Attachment: grafana_cloud_bundle.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Infra telemetry contract review & action plan

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps: 

Meeting: Thu 2026-07-01 09:00 PDT (30m) — vendor working session confirmed (Datadog + Grafana attending).

Action items: 
- (laura_bennett) Pull the Drive worksheet into the shared folder and add the per-environment toggles + current month ingest numbers — due EOD Wed.
- (marissa_cole) Coordinate procurement terms and start an RFP thread if we decide to split non-prod from prod — loop in procurement@vendor-ops.com.
- (hannah_schmitt) Validate compliance requirements for 365-day retention (data classification + access controls) and report any blocking items by 2026-07-07.
- (jonas_weber) Run a quick diffs script to flag services with duplicate log streams to both Datadog and Grafana; list top 10 offenders by Thursday.
- (Sam Park / Elena Rossi / Ravi Shah) Please bring one-page summaries of the cost delta for 30/90/365-day retention and any 12-month commitment discounts.

Procurement note: if vendors can provide committed-usage terms that reduce unit cost materially, we will evaluate a single-vendor strategy for non-prod only and keep Datadog focused on prod APM + critical logs.

I've added the quote links and the Drive folder to the thread metadata. If anything changes before the call, ping me directly.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
